moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-signal-pulse-map, written here): Fixed map; 5 points fire at 400 / 800 / 1200 / 1600 / 2000 ms. Each: dot pops (scale 0 -> 1, 300 ms back.out), two rings radius 4 -> 30 px over 900 ms easeOutCubic, the second 220 ms later, opacity 0.9 -> 0. Optional time rail below with a dot per fire lighting as passed. Fade out 3600-3900. Params: points (5) · interval (0.4 s) · rings (4 → 30 px, 0.9 s).
